summary.goal: Implement a SessionAdapter that reads DecisionEvent records from the planner.db trajectory_events table. This is the simplest integration adapter — one table, one event type (decision), clear field mapping. Sessions are identified by plan_id. Each DecisionEvent has: question_text, options_presented (JSON array), selected_option, free_text_response, reasoning, asking_agent, step_id. These map directly to SessionData.decisions[] with high fidelity. The adapter uses better-sqlite3 to read planner.db directly.

acceptance_criteria.description: Adapter reads from planner.db trajectory_events table using better-sqlite3
Sessions identified by plan_id — listSessions returns distinct plan_ids
DecisionEvent.question_text + selected_option + reasoning -> Decision with title, chosen, reasoning
DecisionEvent.options_presented_json (minus selected) -> Decision.rejected[]
DecisionEvent.asking_agent -> Message with agentName (so we know which agent made the decision)
DecisionEvent.step_id -> metadata on the Decision (links decision to specific plan step)
listSessions supports time range filtering (after/before) using timestamp column
getCursor/setCursor track last processed timestamp per plan_id
Incremental: when cursor exists, only return events after cursor timestamp
Read-only: never INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on planner.db
Config: { dbPath: string } — path to planner.db file
Opens planner.db with { readonly: true } flag in better-sqlite3 — enforced at connection level, not just by convention
Decision.source field set to 'trail' for well-structured decisions from trajectory_events (distinguishes from inferred decisions)

observations: Planner trajectory_events is the simplest source: one event type (decision), well-structured fields
options_presented_json is a JSON string of string[] — needs JSON.parse, then filter out selected_option for rejected[]
asking_agent field tells us which agent asked the question — useful for multi-agent session context
step_id links to specific plan step — enables topic routing by plan scope
DB path can be configured or defaulted to ./planner.db
better-sqlite3 is already a dependency in the monorepo (storage-base uses it)
Uses better-sqlite3 directly (NOT BaseSqliteStorage) — mull is read-only over planner's DB, not the owner

steps.title: Create PlannerDbAdapter class with read-only connection
steps.description: Create packages/mull/src/adapters/planner-db-adapter.ts. Implement a class PlannerDbAdapter that implements SessionAdapter. Constructor accepts { dbPath: string }. Opens planner.db using better-sqlite3 with { readonly: true } flag — this enforces read-only at the SQLite connection level. Do NOT extend BaseSqliteStorage (that is for DB owners; mull is a read-only consumer). Store the db instance as a private field. Implement close() to cleanly shut down the connection.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlannerDbAdapter class created implementing SessionAdapter interface
Constructor opens planner.db with better-sqlite3({ readonly: true })
Does NOT extend BaseSqliteStorage
close() method shuts down the db connection

steps.specification: Location: packages/mull/src/adapters/planner-db-adapter.ts. Uses better-sqlite3 directly (NOT @plannr/storage-base). Config type: PlannerDbAdapterConfig = { dbPath: string }. Constructor: this.db = new Database(config.dbPath, { readonly: true }). Implements SessionAdapter interface. Planner trajectory_events schema: event_id TEXT PK, type TEXT, question_id TEXT, asking_agent TEXT, question_text TEXT, context_provided TEXT, options_presented_json TEXT, selected_option TEXT, free_text_response TEXT, reasoning TEXT, plan_id TEXT FK, step_id TEXT, timestamp TEXT.

steps.title: Implement listSessions with time range filtering
steps.description: Implement listSessions(filter?: { after?: string, before?: string }): SessionRef[]. Query: SELECT DISTINCT plan_id, MIN(timestamp) as first_event, MAX(timestamp) as last_event, COUNT(*) as event_count FROM trajectory_events GROUP BY plan_id. Apply WHERE timestamp > ? / timestamp < ? clauses when after/before filters provided. Return SessionRef[] with id=plan_id, type='planner-trajectory', firstEvent, lastEvent, eventCount.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns distinct plan_ids as SessionRef objects
Supports after/before time range filtering on timestamp column
SessionRef includes firstEvent, lastEvent, eventCount metadata

steps.title: Implement getSession with DecisionEvent to Decision mapping
steps.description: Implement getSession(sessionId: string): SessionData. Query trajectory_events WHERE plan_id = ? ORDER BY timestamp ASC. For each row, map fields: question_text -> Decision.title, selected_option -> Decision.chosen, reasoning -> Decision.reasoning, asking_agent -> Decision.agentName. Parse options_presented_json with JSON.parse, filter out selected_option to build Decision.rejected[]. Set Decision.source = 'trail' to mark these as well-structured decisions from the trajectory table (as opposed to inferred decisions from message parsing). Attach step_id as Decision.metadata.stepId. Wrap all decisions into a SessionData with sessionId=plan_id, decisions[], messages=[] (no raw messages from this source).

acceptance_criteria.description: Maps question_text -> title, selected_option -> chosen, reasoning -> reasoning
Parses options_presented_json, filters out selected to build rejected[]
Sets Decision.source = 'trail' for all mapped decisions
Attaches step_id as metadata.stepId on each Decision
asking_agent mapped to Decision.agentName
Defensive JSON.parse with try/catch — malformed options_presented_json results in empty rejected[], not a crash

steps.title: Implement cursor tracking for incremental processing
steps.description: Implement getCursor(sessionId: string): string | null and setCursor(sessionId: string, cursor: string): void. Cursors are stored in .mull/cursors/planner/{plan_id}.json with { lastTimestamp: string, lastProcessedAt: string }. getCursor reads the file and returns lastTimestamp. setCursor writes the file. When getSession is called and a cursor exists, add WHERE timestamp > ? to only return events after the cursor. This enables incremental processing — only new decisions since last mull run.

acceptance_criteria.description: Cursors persisted to .mull/cursors/planner/{plan_id}.json
getCursor returns lastTimestamp string or null if no cursor file
setCursor writes cursor file with lastTimestamp and lastProcessedAt
getSession respects cursor — only returns events after cursor timestamp when cursor exists

steps.title: Write tests with in-memory SQLite
steps.description: Create packages/mull/src/adapters/__tests__/planner-db-adapter.test.ts. Use better-sqlite3 with ':memory:' to create a test database. Create the trajectory_events table with the same schema as planner's migration. Insert test DecisionEvent rows with known values. Test: listSessions returns correct plan_ids, getSession maps all fields correctly, options_presented_json parsing produces correct rejected[], cursor tracking filters events incrementally, time range filtering works, malformed JSON in options_presented_json handled gracefully, empty result sets return empty arrays. Use Vitest.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests use in-memory SQLite with planner trajectory_events schema
Tests cover: listSessions, getSession field mapping, rejected[] derivation, cursor tracking, time range filtering
Tests cover edge cases: malformed JSON, empty result sets, missing optional fields
All tests pass with Vitest
